concepts.name: 01-play-stop
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished square app icon concept for ReelsBan, a Korean digital wellbeing app that limits short-video scrolling and helps people return to real life. Current brand uses bold minimal black and white. Full-bleed solid near-black square background, central warm-white bold geometric symbol, generous 22% safe margins. Flat vector-like precision, distinctive custom graphic identity, strong silhouette legible at 32 pixels. No text, no letters, no captions, no watermarks, no mockup, no shadows, no gradients, no extra borders. This is a single icon, not a presentation sheet. A custom play triangle interrupted by a decisive diagonal negative-space cut: the two remaining white pieces suggest a play button decisively stopped. Visually balanced, original geometry, few elements. Communicate stopping compulsive short-video playback.
